verdict.rationale: The Drive API's own reference includes a `changes` resource, described as "A change to a file or shared drive," which points to a first-party change feed. Push notifications that alert when watched resources change support a delta-driven sync pattern. However, the pack does not document the cursor/page-token mechanics, the list-changes call, or that it returns only changes since the last call, so the delta-sync capability is only implied. Missing for 10: documented cursor/start-page-token semantics, an explicit list-changes-since-token endpoint description, guidance on avoiding full re-crawls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync efficiently — a cursor/delta endpoint returns only what changed since my last call instead of forcing a full re-crawl

citations.quote: A change to a file or shared drive.
The Google Drive API provides push notifications that let you monitor changes in resources.
Whenever a watched resource changes, the Google Drive API notifies your application.
